llama.scope: LLMLingua-derived main conditions only; unchanged methods retain their saved evidence
llama.logical_request_id: SHA256 of exact system/user prompts, model ID/revision, dtype, greedy flag, attention, and input/output token limits; execution batch and library versions are separately recorded.
llama.reuse: Original parsed scores are reused only for exactly unchanged contexts. Original raw answers are reused only for identical prompt/model/attention/token settings. Reused rows retain their original execution provenance.
llama.limitations: Reader-score deltas combine corrected selections with recorded software/runtime changes and are not an experiment isolating the parser as the sole cause of every token difference.

runtime_comparison.P1_batch: Historical batch 8 / token budget 8000; corrected primary batch 8 / token budget 8000. Earlier batch 4 outputs are diagnostic only.
runtime_comparison.P2_P3_batch: Corrected primary uses serial batch 1, preserving the original main workers. Earlier batched outputs are diagnostic only.

mistral.scope: LLMLingua-derived main conditions only; unchanged methods retain their saved evidence
mistral.logical_request_id: SHA256 of exact system/user prompts, model ID/revision, dtype, greedy flag, attention, and input/output token limits; execution batch and library versions are separately recorded.
mistral.reuse: Original parsed scores are reused only for exactly unchanged contexts. Original raw answers are reused only for identical prompt/model/attention/token settings. Reused rows retain their original execution provenance.
mistral.limitations: Reader-score deltas combine corrected selections with recorded software/runtime changes and are not an experiment isolating the parser as the sole cause of every token difference.

runtime_comparison.original_revision: Not recorded in the original saved Mistral outputs
runtime_comparison.revision_comparability: New explicitly pinned rerun; equality with the unrecorded original revision cannot be established
runtime_comparison.original_runtime_versions: Not recorded in original Mistral raw outputs
runtime_comparison.preserved_settings: bfloat16; greedy; P2 SDPA / P3 eager attention; serial batch 1; max input 7168 / max new tokens 128
